title: Deployment identity proofing needs sponsor and registration authority evidence
remediation: The deployment sponsor establishes the required identity assurance levels and names the registration authority and privacy owner. The registration authority records how it resolves a unique individual, receives identity evidence, validates and verifies it, performs the applicable in-person check and sends out-of-band confirmation to the recorded address. Collect approved procedures and redacted attestations or authorized evidence references. Document sponsor-approved applicability decisions and keep identity documents in the authorized storage location.

milestones.title: Record sponsor-approved assurance and scope and collect registration authority attestations for evidence receipt, validation and verification, applicable in-person checks and address confirmation
